feed.h: Prediction-market companies have spent at least $3 million influencing federal and state governments this year
feed.b: A Stateline analysis of OpenSecrets data found Kalshi has registered lobbyists in 41 states. In the first half of 2026 it gave $100,000 to the Republican Governors Association, $150,000 to the Democratic Governors Association, and more than $300,000 combined to the two parties' attorneys general associations.

src.t: Prediction markets spend millions to influence state, federal governments
Prediction Markets Spend Millions To Influence State, Federal Governments

feed.h: Victor Wembanyama says he will not endorse betting companies
feed.b: Speaking at Spurs practice, Wembanyama called NBA players' gambling endorsements "very sad" and said athletes should use their influence to inspire people in a good way.

src.t: Spurs star Victor Wembanyama calls NBA players endorsing sports betting 'very sad'

feed.h: Bettor sues DraftKings, alleging it used AI to target customers likely to lose
feed.b: West Virginia bettor Daniel Vest filed a proposed class action in federal court in Boston on Sept. 26. He says DraftKings broke Massachusetts law by not disclosing AI-driven targeting, and that he received about 70 messages from the company in one month. DraftKings says it does not use AI to target customers based on losses. These are allegations; nothing has been decided.

src.t: DraftKings 'weaponized' AI to target gamblers, encouraging addiction, lawsuit says

feed.h: CFTC reportedly sends two prediction-market rules to the White House for review
feed.b: One trade outlet reports the CFTC sent the White House regulatory office a proposal defining event contracts as swaps and an interim rule excluding casino-style products. Neither has been published. A separate CFTC proposal on event-contract reviews ran in the Federal Register on June 12.

src.t: The CFTC has sent prediction market rules to the White House. States are still in court
Prediction Markets; Public Interest Determinations

feed.h: Chauncey Billups's rigged-poker trial is set to begin Nov. 2
feed.b: The judge denied the government's request to push the trial to January. Fifteen of the 31 defendants in the poker case have pleaded guilty. Billups has pleaded not guilty. Prosecutors say victims lost at least $7 million.

src.t: Chauncey Billups Set For November 2 Trial In Federal Rigged-Poker Case
Trial date set for Chauncey Billups, others in rigged poker case

feed.h: Sixth Circuit rules Ohio and Tennessee can enforce betting laws against Kalshi
feed.b: The unanimous panel found Kalshi's sports contracts are not swaps under federal commodities law. Kalshi has now lost two of three federal appeals. On Oct. 2, Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine called the contracts illegal gambling and said the state will enforce its law.

src.t: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi
Kalshi loses appeal over Ohio and Tennessee sports betting laws, widening circuit split
Kalshi is illegal gambling and Ohio will enforce state law following ruling, says DeWine

feed.h: Massachusetts regulators will review how sportsbooks use AI, starting with DraftKings
feed.b: Gaming Commission chair Jordan Maynard said the review will start with DraftKings and then cover every licensed sportsbook. The commission said it has not found wrongdoing.

src.t: Massachusetts to Evaluate Sportsbooks' AI Practices
Massachusetts gaming commission probes DraftKings AI practices

feed.h: Indiana rejects the NCAA's request to ban all college player prop bets
feed.b: The Indiana Gaming Commission voted unanimously to keep its current rules, which allow pregame college player props and ban in-game ones. Commissioners said the legislature should decide.

src.t: Indiana Regulators Reject NCAA's Request for Full Ban on College Player Props
EndGame: Regulators Discuss College Prop Bets, Sportsbooks' Use Of AI To Target Gamblers

feed.h: North Carolina fines Underdog $175,000 over underage accounts and bet365 $75,000 over self-excluded customers
feed.b: Regulators said Underdog failed to verify 38 underage accounts, eight of which placed bets, and bet365 sent push notifications to people on the self-exclusion list. Both companies reported the problems themselves.

src.t: North Carolina Regulators Fine Underdog, bet365 for Sports Betting Violations
North Carolina Fines bet365, Underdog for RG Violations

feed.h: Prediction-market trading doubled from May to July, driven by sports
feed.b: Pew's analysis of The Block's data shows combined Kalshi and Polymarket volume rose from $25.7 billion in May to $53.0 billion in July. Sports trading in June and July topped $58 billion on Kalshi and neared $22 billion on Polymarket. These are notional volumes, not directly comparable to sportsbook handle.

src.t: Prediction markets' trading volume doubled between May and July, largely driven by sports

feed.h: Caesars shareholders approve Tilman Fertitta's $17.6 billion buyout
feed.b: The all-cash, $31-per-share deal includes Caesars Sportsbook. Fertitta also takes on about $12 billion of Caesars debt. Federal Trade Commission review is continuing.

src.t: Caesars stockholders approve $17.6 billion Fertitta buyout
Caesars shareholders approve Fertitta merger while FTC review continues

feed.h: Problem-gambling council hardens its stance on prediction markets after a Kalshi funding backlash
feed.b: Axios reported Kalshi joined the National Council on Problem Gambling in May with $2 million in funding. The Nevada and Evergreen problem-gambling councils have since left, and Michigan's gaming regulator ended its membership.

src.t: National gambling group takes firmer stance on prediction markets
NCPG takes firmer stance on prediction markets after Kalshi controversy

feed.h: New York Times reports DraftKings used machine learning to aim promotions at customers predicted to lose the most
feed.b: Citing former employees and internal documents, the Times reported a scoring system built in 2023, about $400 million in automated 2025 promotions, and a shelved model meant to detect harm. DraftKings disputes the reporting; its CEO called it slanderous. We have not seen the underlying documents.

src.t: Losing gamblers pushed to bet more by DraftKings' AI, report says
DraftKings' Promotional AI Scored Bettors by Addiction Markers, NYT Investigation Finds
DraftKings CEO Says New York Times Has Been Writing 'Slanderous' Stories

feed.h: Gambling-disorder ER visits roughly doubled in Ontario after online betting expanded
feed.b: A peer-reviewed study in the American Journal of Preventive Medicine covering 14 years of data found visits far above expected levels for young men, including 154% higher for males aged 10 to 29. The data is Canadian.

src.t: Emergency Department Visits for Gambling Disorders After the Legalization of Single-Event Sports Betting
Gambling disorder emergency visits increase following sports betting legalization

feed.h: Pennsylvania bettor sues DraftKings and FanDuel over VIP managers
feed.b: Reynaldo Rivera alleges VIP hosts deepened his addiction. He says he wagered $1.6 million on DraftKings and lost about $97,000, and wagered $841,000 on FanDuel and lost about $40,000. These are allegations.

src.t: DraftKings, FanDuel Lawsuit Alleges VIP Managers Fueled More Than $130K in Gambling Losses

feed.h: Ninth Circuit sides with two California tribes against Kalshi
feed.b: The court found Kalshi's sports contracts likely count as gaming under federal Indian gaming law when traded from tribal land, and reversed a lower court's refusal to block them.

src.t: The Ninth Circuit finds Kalshi sports contracts on tribal lands likely violate federal law
Tribal Nations Step Up Fight Against Prediction Markets

feed.h: Bank of America data: online bettors get back about 75 cents of every dollar they wager
feed.b: Fortune reported the Bank of America Institute's findings. Gen Z and millennials made up 88% of betting activity in July, and median deposit balances in betting households were 59% of those in non-betting households.

src.t: One in five Americans call sports betting an investment

feed.h: LeBron James signs with Polymarket
feed.b: It is Polymarket's first individual athlete endorsement. The campaign also features Eli Manning, Derek Jeter, Spike Lee and Sue Bird. Terms were not disclosed.

src.t: LeBron James teases partnership with Polymarket
LeBron James is partnering with Polymarket

feed.h: New Jersey asks the Supreme Court to let states regulate Kalshi's sports contracts
feed.b: It is the first state petition to the Court on prediction markets. New Jersey is challenging the Third Circuit's April ruling, which shielded Kalshi from state gambling law.

src.t: Petition for Writ of Certiorari
New Jersey asks Supreme Court to resolve fight over Kalshi's future

feed.h: Guardians pitchers Emmanuel Clase and Luis Ortiz will be tried together starting Nov. 2
feed.b: Prosecutors later narrowed the pitch-rigging case to 18 pitches by Clase and two by Ortiz. Both have pleaded not guilty.

src.t: Federal Judge Rules Guardians Pitchers Will Face Pitch-Rigging Case Together
Prosecutors Narrow Emmanuel Clase Betting Case to 18 Pitches

feed.h: Ninth Circuit rules Nevada can apply its gaming laws to Kalshi
feed.b: The panel found Kalshi's sports contracts likely are not swaps, so federal law does not block Nevada. The ruling also covers Crypto.com and Robinhood, and it split from the Third Circuit.

src.t: Ninth Circuit win for Nevada over Kalshi sets up potential Supreme Court showdown
Ninth Circuit opinion, No. 25-7516

feed.h: Sportsbooks added $29 million to their super PAC in the second quarter, bringing it to $72 million
feed.b: DraftKings gave $14.5 million, FanDuel $7.5 million, bet365 $5.5 million and Fanatics $1.5 million to Win for America from April through June. The PAC grew 70% from $43 million at the end of March.

src.t: Corporate Money in the 2026 Midterms Surges to $650 Million
Win for America committee overview

feed.h: NFL renews DraftKings and FanDuel, adds Fanatics, and drops Caesars
feed.b: The multiyear deals drop the old exclusivity language, so the league can add more sportsbooks. Financial terms were not disclosed.

src.t: NFL announces official partnerships with three leading sports betting operators
NFL renews sportsbook deals with DraftKings and FanDuel, adds Fanatics

feed.h: Colorado fines Fanatics $20,000 after VIP staff twice marketed to a self-excluded customer
feed.b: Fanatics must also audit its self-exclusion compliance from January 2024 to March 2026 and retrain its VIP team.

src.t: Colorado Fines Fanatics Sportsbook For Marketing Violations

feed.h: Kalshi signs five MLB teams; Polymarket signs the Yankees
feed.b: Kalshi's deals are with the Braves, Red Sox, Dodgers, Padres and Giants. Fortune reported Kalshi's baseball volume at nearly $13 billion this year. A report that Kalshi is negotiating a league-wide MLB deal rests on one unnamed source.

src.t: Kalshi strikes deals with five MLB teams, eyes a separate league partnership
Kalshi partners with 5 MLB teams
Polymarket Becomes An Official Prediction Market Partner of the New York Yankees

feed.h: MLB players' union tells Congress the league resisted a joint push to ban player prop bets
feed.b: Answering lawmakers' questions about VIP marketing tied to MLB, the union and FanDuel, the MLBPA said it is open to rules barring players from sportsbook VIP marketing.

src.t: MLBPA says league 'balked' at lobbying to ban props

feed.h: Nebraska will vote on online sports betting in November, in a campaign reportedly funded by FanDuel and DraftKings
feed.b: Two measures were certified for the Nov. 3 ballot. Trade outlets report the Tax Relief Nebraska campaign got about $3.5 million each from FanDuel and DraftKings. We have not yet checked state filings.

src.t: Nebraska Online Sports Betting Will Go to November Ballot
Backers of online sports betting in Nebraska submit signatures to get on 2026 ballot

feed.h: Sportsbook-funded groups have spent nearly $12 million on Georgia's elections
feed.b: An update of Atlanta Journal-Constitution figures, as summarized by a trade outlet, says 32 of the 34 legislative candidates the network backed in primaries won.

src.t: Sports Betting Groups Pour Millions Into Georgia Elections

feed.h: Gallup: 11% of adults bet on sports in the past year
feed.b: Overall gambling fell to 45% from 64% in 2016, by telephone survey. Gallup's sports figure is lower than Pew's 22%; question wording and method differ.

src.t: Fewer U.S. Adults Say They Gamble

feed.h: Kalshi reportedly in talks to raise $750 million at a $40 billion valuation
feed.b: CoinDesk, citing The Information, reported that Sequoia and Wellington were in advanced talks to lead the round. Neither company confirmed. Kalshi was valued at $22 billion in March.

src.t: Sequoia and Wellington in talks to lead $750 million Kalshi funding round

feed.h: DraftKings revenue falls 5% while marketing spending jumps to $322.5 million
feed.b: Second-quarter revenue was $1.44 billion with a $67.6 million net loss. Monthly unique payers rose 9% to 3.6 million. The company said its prediction-market product has passed 600,000 customers this year.

src.t: DraftKings Reports Second Quarter Results
DraftKings (DKNG) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript

feed.h: FanDuel's owner posts a $296 million loss and replaces its CEO
feed.b: Flutter's U.S. revenue fell 6% to $1.68 billion even as average monthly players rose 9% to 3.8 million. U.S. marketing spending rose 61% year over year. Dan Taylor became CEO on Oct. 1.

src.t: Flutter Entertainment Announces Q2 2026 Financial Results
Flutter posts $296m Q2 loss as Dan Taylor named next CEO

feed.h: New Jersey fines Caesars Sportsbook $251,250 over self-exclusion failures
feed.b: Regulators also required $45,465 in disgorgement. Problems included letting self-excluded players bet through other platforms.

src.t: Caesars Sportsbook hit with $250k fine by New Jersey regulator
Caesars Sportsbook Fined $296,715 in New Jersey

feed.h: New York's attorney general sues Kalshi, seeking about $36 billion
feed.b: Letitia James calls Kalshi an illegal gambling operation and wants it to stop offering contracts on sports and other events. The amount is what the state is asking for, not a judgment. Kalshi called the suit political theater.

src.t: New York sues Kalshi, claiming prediction contracts violate state gambling laws
New York A.G. Letitia James sues Kalshi for $36 billion over 'illegal gambling'

feed.h: IG Group agrees to buy Underdog in a deal worth up to $1.3 billion
feed.b: About $380 million is paid upfront; the rest depends on an earnout and incentive plan through 2029. Underdog later gave up fantasy licenses in seven states to focus on prediction markets.

src.t: In Underdog $1.3B Sale, A Lesson In Weathering US Changes
UK's IG Group bets big on US prediction markets with $1.3 billion Underdog deal

feed.h: The Mets become the first MLB team with a prediction-market partner
feed.b: The team signed Novig. Terms were not disclosed.

src.t: Novig Named Exclusive Official Prediction Market Partner of the New York Mets

feed.h: Betting industry's midterm spending passes $72 million, routed through two partisan affiliates
feed.b: Reuters reported Win for America moves money through the Republican-aligned American Conservative Fund and the Democratic-aligned American Future. FEC data shows $68.05 million passed to other committees through June.

src.t: Sports betting industry spending on US midterm elections surpasses $72 million
Win for America committee overview

feed.h: Bipartisan House bill would ban sports contracts on prediction markets
feed.b: Nevada Reps. Steven Horsford and Mark Amodei introduced the Prediction Markets Are Gambling Act. Sen. Catherine Cortez Masto introduced a Senate version in March.

src.t: Horsford and Amodei Introduce Bipartisan Bill to Ban Sports Prediction Market Contracts

feed.h: Second-quarter lobbying: Kalshi $500,000, AGA $660,000, DraftKings $350,000
feed.b: These are in-house federal lobbying expenses from Senate disclosure filings. Outside firms report their fees separately.

src.t: LDA filings, client Kalshi, 2026
LDA filings, client DraftKings, 2026
Prediction Markets and Casinos Are Both Betting Big on Washington

feed.h: NFL suspends Cardinals scouting director Ryan Gold for gambling
feed.b: The league said he placed parlays and allegedly shared nonpublic draft information. It found no sign that games were compromised. His lawyer denies the allegations.

src.t: NFL suspends Cardinals executive for violating gambling policy
NFL suspends Cardinals scouting director Ryan Gold indefinitely

feed.h: Illinois starts taxing prediction-market trades; the CFTC sues to stop it
feed.b: The tax is 1.75% per transaction for an operator's first 5 million trades and 3.5% after that. The CFTC amended its suit against Illinois to challenge it.

src.t: CFTC Expands Illinois Lawsuit to Target New Prediction Market Tax

feed.h: North Carolina raises its online sports betting tax from 18% to 23%
feed.b: The budget also adds a 6% tax on prediction-market operators starting in 2027.

src.t: NC Budget Targets Sportsbooks, Prediction Markets With New Taxes

feed.h: Former NBA players Malik Beasley and Ed Davis charged in expanded betting case
feed.b: Prosecutors accuse Beasley of altering his play to match prop bets while with the Bucks in 2024. He pleaded not guilty.

src.t: Former players Malik Beasley, Ed Davis charged in NBA gambling scandal

feed.h: Kalshi gave $39,200 to Xavier Becerra days before California's primary
feed.b: CalMatters found Kalshi had also given $115,000 to state candidates and $100,000 to the state Democratic Party since mid-2025, while its own market gave Becerra high odds.

src.t: Kalshi gives Becerra high odds of winning. They also bet on his campaign

feed.h: Sports betting is now the main problem in more than a quarter of national helpline contacts
feed.b: Sports betting was the primary gambling type in 27.3% of 2025 helpline conversations, up from 22.3% in 2024.

src.t: National Problem Gambling Helpline 2025 Annual Report

feed.h: Pennsylvania senators defended by sportsbook money all win their primaries
feed.b: Win for Pennsylvania spent more than $5 million protecting three GOP state senators against challengers backed by skill-game interests.

src.t: Gambling interests pour millions into key PA Senate primaries
PA primary election results: Gaming-targeted senators win

feed.h: About $10 million in sportsbook money enters Georgia's legislative primaries
feed.b: The AJC found it backed leaders including House Speaker Jon Burns and Senate Majority Leader Jason Anavitarte.

src.t: Sports betting industry pours $10M into Georgia campaigns

feed.h: Damon Jones is the first to plead guilty in the NBA gambling cases
feed.b: He pleaded guilty to two wire-fraud conspiracy counts, covering betting on nonpublic injury information and the rigged poker games.

src.t: Ex-NBA player Damon Jones 1st to plead guilty in gambling case

feed.h: Test accounts set up as 15-year-olds were shown gambling promotions on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram
feed.b: The Institute for Strategic Dialogue found all three platforms surfaced betting and prediction-market content, mostly through influencers and athletes.

src.t: Pathways to parlays

feed.h: More than half of men aged 18 to 49 have an active online sportsbook account
feed.b: Siena's survey found 27% of all Americans and 52% of men 18 to 49 had an active account, up from 22% and 48% a year earlier.

src.t: ASFS 2026 Release 2: Sports Betting

feed.h: DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics and bet365 revealed as funders of a new super PAC
feed.b: Axios reported Win for America had spent more than $20 million across six states and planned to get involved in 15 more.

src.t: Exclusive: DraftKings, FanDuel, Fanatics fund sports betting super PAC

feed.h: New York Fed: legal betting raises credit delinquencies, most among people under 40
feed.b: Delinquency rose about 0.3 points overall after legalization, and credit-card delinquency rose 1.02 points among borrowers under 40.

src.t: Sports Betting Is Everywhere, Especially on Credit Reports

feed.h: MLB names Polymarket its exclusive prediction-market partner
feed.b: MLB did not announce a price. Unnamed sources gave conflicting figures, from about $150 million to $300 million, so we do not record an amount.

src.t: MLB reaches agreements with Polymarket, federal commission
MLB Makes Multiyear Prediction-Market Deal With Polymarket

feed.h: Americans bet $166.9 billion legally in 2025 and lost $17 billion of it
feed.b: Sportsbook revenue, the money bettors lost, rose 22.8% to $16.96 billion. States collected $3.71 billion in taxes.

src.t: U.S. commercial gaming revenue hits record $78.72 billion in 2025, AGA reports

feed.h: 36% of boys aged 11 to 17 gambled in the past year
feed.b: Common Sense Media found nearly one in eight bet on sports and 60% saw gambling ads on YouTube or social media.

src.t: New Research on Adolescent Boys' Gambling Habits

feed.h: 26 charged, including college basketball players, in a point-shaving case
feed.b: Prosecutors in Philadelphia allege players took bribes to fix games. The alleged organizer pleaded guilty in March.

src.t: College basketball players among dozens charged in wide-ranging point-shaving scheme
Jalen Smith Pleads Guilty in Bribery and Point-Shaving Scheme

feed.h: Prediction-market lobby hires two former congressmen
feed.b: The Coalition for Prediction Markets named ex-Rep. Sean Patrick Maloney CEO and former House Financial Services chair Patrick McHenry senior adviser.

src.t: The Coalition for Prediction Markets Names Former U.S. Congressman Sean Patrick Maloney as CEO

feed.h: FanDuel gives $500,000 to each party's congressional leadership super PACs
feed.b: The four recipients were the Senate Leadership Fund, Congressional Leadership Fund, Senate Majority PAC and House Majority PAC. DraftKings gave $500,000 to the Senate Leadership Fund on Dec. 16.

src.t: DraftKings and FanDuel spending millions on 2026 midterms, new filings reveal

feed.h: Win for America super PAC registers with the FEC
feed.b: It later emerged as the sportsbook industry's main vehicle for the 2026 midterms.

src.t: Win for America committee overview

feed.h: Guardians pitchers indicted on charges of rigging pitches for bettors
feed.b: Emmanuel Clase and Luis Ortiz face wire fraud, bribery and money laundering charges. Both pleaded not guilty.

src.t: Two Current Major League Baseball Players Charged with Sports Betting and Money Laundering

feed.h: Federal prosecutors charge Terry Rozier, Chauncey Billups and Damon Jones
feed.b: More than 30 people were arrested in two cases, one over betting on NBA inside information and one over rigged poker games prosecutors tie to organized crime.

src.t: Billups, Rozier among over 30 arrested in two federal gambling-related investigations
